source_en: Relax, officer. Just a businessman coming home. Vladimir Syrnikov, import and logistics.
I own property in six districts. You're standing in one of my doorways.
Everything belongs to someone eventually. I'm paying attention.
You will. Or someone who answers to me will introduce us.
My imports aren't your paperwork. Shame if something {{made your job harder}}.
It's logistics. Don't smudge the ink. I like things clean.
Of course you do. We'll see what that costs you.
Respect the papers, officer. Respect the transaction.
